item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. You have no notes today, so start simple. Eating well is mostly about timing and decisions made before you're hungry. Your day already has structure, so use it. Pick when your next meal happens and what it is, rather than grabbing whatever is close. Eat slowly enough to notice when you're full. Action: right now, decide your next meal and write it down.
